newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Explorers Index up on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Australian Explorers Index up on bargain hunting.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index jumped 77.7 points or 2.8 percent last week. The All Ordinaries Index eased 0.55 percent.
July 18 July 11 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
Eyres Reed analyst Glen Colgan said in a commentary that volumes were sharply lower as small resource sector investors reeled from last week's heavy sell-off.
Bargain hunters were prevalent as bullion prices steadied and gains just outnumbered falls, he said.
The strongest riser was Troy Resources NL, which rose 15 cents to A$1.05. Other strong movers were Dalrymple Resources NL, up 11 cents to 40 cents, and Western Reefs Ltd, up seven cents to 42 cents.
The largest fall was recored by Eagle Bay Resources NL which fell seven cents to 18 cents.
